biggest_catch: Earnings depend on winning students in a competitive marketplace — nothing is guaranteed.
catches: You set your own rate, but winning students requires a strong profile, reviews, and ranking in search.
Students purchase your contact details to begin tuition (per the official how-it-works page), which can deter enquiries.
UK-focused marketplace; tutors set their own hourly rates — variable.
Official site states the service is free for tutors; the platform monetizes the student side.
